note: Alert thresholds per thermal zone category, in degrees C. These are conservative alert levels for a diagnostic tool, not vendor shutdown limits. CPU/GPU run hot under normal load, so their limit is much higher than skin or battery. Zones that match no category are reported but not judged.

battery.reason: Li-ion cells should not exceed ~50 C; charging normally stops near 45 C.

skin.reason: Device surface temperature; above ~45 C is uncomfortable and Android starts throttling.

usb_port.reason: Connector temperature; a hot port can indicate moisture or debris.

cpu.reason: SoC junction; 70-90 C under load is normal.

gpu.reason: GPU junction; 70-90 C under load is normal.
